messages.subject: Program DISTANCE update
parts:
Hi Distance Samplers,

An update on program Distance:


1. The web site address for downloading Distance has been changed slightly,
to:

http://nmml.afsc.noaa.gov/distance/map.htm

This site allows you to download the current versions of Distance 2.2 (dos
based) and 3.0 (windows console based).


2. The next version of Distance (version 3.5) is now in the final stages of
development (i.e., incorporating feedback from participants in our recent
distance sampling workshop). It will be publicly released at the end of
October. We will also be re-vamping the web site at that time and probably
transferring most of the web pages to a UK site, with the program download
mirrored at the US site.

We will be announcing the new release and the new web site address on this
list in a month or so.

- Len Thomas


--
Len Thomas (l...@dcs.st-and.ac.uk)
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland
